name: Accordion
intro: Put each Item in Root, with its ItemTrigger and ItemContent inside the same item. Each item needs a unique, nonempty value. Wrap ItemTrigger in a heading when the panel introduces a section; choose the heading level for the page. ItemIndicator is optional.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: Provides the expanded values shared by its items. Native div props pass through, and its ref points to the root element.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allows several items to remain expanded.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially expanded item values for uncontrolled state.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled expanded values; update this prop after a change callback.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the expanded values change or a controlled change is requested.

props.name: ids
props.type: { root?: string; itemContent?: (value: string) => string; itemTrigger?: (value: string) => string }
props.description: Overrides generated part IDs. Use Root IDs when a label or external control needs a stable input or trigger target.

parts.name: Item
parts.description: Groups a trigger and panel under one value.

props.name: value
props.description: Unique, nonempty value used in Root's expanded-value array.

data.purpose: Style the open and closed states.
Style the open and closed states.

parts.name: ItemContent
parts.description: Contains the panel content. Closed panels are hidden.

data.purpose: Style the open and closed states.

parts.name: ItemIndicator
parts.description: The default icon changes with the expanded state.

props.name: children
props.description: Replaces the default icon with content or a render function based on the item state.

accessibility: Users can activate a focused trigger with Enter or Space. The component associates each trigger with its panel and hides closed panels. Provide meaningful trigger text and headings where appropriate.
